ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The legend on the right side of the figure shows elements such as a science and technology zone, living zone, industrial zone, green area, agricultural area, as well as highways and railway passenger stations. Number ② in the figure is located in the northern part of the city, close to the science and technology zone represented by diagonal-line texture, and there are transportation lines and a railway passenger station nearby. There are industrial zones near numbers ⑤ and ⑥, and number ① is located inside the living zone. Reasoning: A university undertakes the functions of talent training, scientific research, and technological development, and is suitable to be close to a science and technology zone, facilitating industry-university-research connections; at the same time, it should avoid the pollution influence of industrial zones as much as possible. Therefore ② should be selected.

raw_record.question_text:
Figure 2 is a functional zoning map of a certain city in a plain area of southern China. Read the figure and complete:

<image1>

The city plans to build a university. Which location in the figure is most suitable for its layout?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：根据图例，图中有科技区、生活区、工业区、绿地区、农业区及道路、铁路客运站等；编号2位于城市北部的科技区附近，交通线也较近。再推理：题干要求为“大学”选址，大学与科研、技术开发、人才培养联系最紧密，宜靠近科技区且避开工业污染区。比较各编号后，2与大学功能最匹配，故选2。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中右侧图例显示有科技区、生活区、工业区、绿地区、农业区，以及公路、铁路客运站等要素。图中编号②位于城市北部，靠近带斜线纹理表示的科技区，并且附近有交通线和铁路客运站。编号⑤、⑥附近有工业区，编号①位于生活区内部。
推理：大学承担人才培养、科研和技术开发功能，适宜靠近科技区，便于产学研联系；同时应尽量避开工业区的污染影响。比较各编号位置，②最接近科技区且交通较便利，最符合大学选址要求。因此应选②。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A university has teaching, research, innovation and talent-training functions, so it is most compatible with a science/technology zone and benefits from nearby transport while needing to avoid industrial pollution. Therefore the candidate in the 科技区 is preferred.
